title: PM-Eng 1:1 prep - Priya Shah / Lucas Martin
content:
Goal: prep for 1:1 with Priya. Align on ship checklist for API throttling changes, console rollout for per-route dashboards, Dedicated capacity forecast, and Private deployment onboarding. Leave meeting with concrete owners and dates.

Agenda:
1) Quick wins / FYI (5m)
   - Latency P50/P95 update from last deploy: P50 ~42ms, P95 ~210ms for small-gen routes (from infra dashboard). Backend batcher improvements landing next week (PR #6789).
   - Cost anomaly: unexpected token-cost spike in embeddings endpoint (saw +18% token usage q/q) — Aisha flagged.
2) API throttling + rate limiting plan (15m)
   - Current situation: global burst policy causes 503s during traffic spikes for mid-tier customers.
   - Proposal: introduce per-customer leaky bucket with soft 429 at 85% utilization, fallback routing to dedicated-compatible model when capacity constrained.
   - Risks: increased latency for routed requests; DB/config rollout complexity.
   - Ask for Lucas: rough effort estimate (engineer-weeks) for implementing soft-429 + routing fallback and can we have a canary in region-us-west by end of March?
3) Console per-route dashboards (10m)
   - Priya: PM wants to ship minimal viable per-route cost/latency view for enterprise beta (need top-10 routes, token breakdown, model variant).
   - Implementation note: tracing hooks exist but need aggregation layer + new time-series to store tokens-per-request.
   - Ask: what footprint does the aggregation agent add? Any perf impact? Can we reuse existing tracing infra?
4) Dedicated capacity forecast & autoscale policy (10m)
   - Sales committed 4 Dedicated contracts (Q2) — baseline capacity needed by May 1.
   - Discussion points: GPU pool sizing, burst buffer behavior, SLA implications.
   - Action: Lucas to confirm if the current autoscaler supports guaranteed reservation + burst and if not, estimate work to add it.
5) Private (VPC/on-prem) onboarding checklist (10m)
   - Security checklist: KMS integration, audit logs, controlled egress.
   - Ops checklist: installer packaging, compatibility matrix for customer infra (NVIDIA Ampere vs H100), and support runbook.
   - Ask: can we prepare an "onboarding quick-run" doc for SRE to execute first PoC within 2 weeks?
6) Blockers & escalations (5m)
   - PR #6791 (batcher rollback) is blocked on perf tests — need SRE time.
   - Hiring update: still short 1 infra SWE for serving runtime; timeline to hire?

Notes to self / context:
- Priorities: (A) ensure no regressions to P95 on small-gen endpoints after batcher changes, (B) ship per-route console beta to enterprise trial customers, (C) secure Dedicated commits.
- Metrics to show in 1:1: 7-day moving average token cost per route, error-rate by model-variant, Dedicated queue length and successful fallback percentage.
- Quick links: confluence page for "Hosted API Roadmap" + JIRA-INF-2345 (api-throttling feature), PR 6789 (batcher improvements), PR 6791 (batcher rollback perf tests).

Open questions I want Priya to answer:
- Which customers are highest priority for per-route dashboards? (Priya has a shortlist: Acme, Orbital, Beacon)
- For Dedicated contracts, what are the SLAs being promised in the sales deck? (I need the exact latency and uptime numbers to map to infra targets)
- Any legal/customer constraints for Private quick PoC (e.g., no internet egress)?

Action items (owner / due):
- Lucas: rough estimate for soft-429 + fallback routing (engineer-weeks) — due 2026-03-10.
- Lucas / Aisha: confirm aggregation agent footprint and reuse options for tracing infra — due 2026-03-08.
- Priya: confirm enterprise beta customer list for per-route dashboards and sample dataset — due 2026-03-05.
- Sam (SRE): prioritize perf tests for PR #6791 and give ETA on results — due 2026-03-06.
- Lucas / SRE: prepare Private onboarding quick-run doc / checklist for first PoC — due 2026-03-15.
- Priya: share sales deck with exact Dedicated SLAs and committed start dates — due 2026-03-04.

Prep talking points / scripts:
- If Priya asks about timeline compression for per-route dashboards: propose phased delivery — Phase 1 (top-10 routes + token counts) in 3 weeks, Phase 2 (model-variant breakdown + histograms) in 6 weeks.
- For API throttling: recommend conservative canary (5% traffic) with instant fallback to queued dedicated pool to avoid 503s.

Post-meeting follow-up template (to send after):
- Subject: Recap + action items from 1:1 (Priya / Lucas)
- Body: short bullets of decisions, owners & due dates, links to tickets/PRs, next check-in date.

Rough timeline sketch:
- Mar 3-10: estimates + perf test results
- Mar 11-24: implement soft-429 + routing fallback (canary by Mar 24)
- Mar 25-Apr 8: per-route console Phase 1 rollout to beta customers
- Apr 15-May 1: Dedicated capacity provisioning & customer onboarding (dependent on sales contracts)

Misc notes (brainstorm / open):
- Could use sampling-based aggregation for tokens to avoid high cardinality in TSDB. Tradeoff: sampling bias vs storage cost.
- Consider a "fallback budget" metric surfaced in console so product and sales can see how often customers fall back to lower-cost variants.

End of prep.

(Will convert selected bits into Confluence follow-up and create / link JIRA tickets after the meeting.)
